comment: The text says the Client Registry cannot be governed unilaterally by the Ministry of Health because its data is referenced across government. Cross-government reference should not automatically give other sectors governance rights over health-identity data.

public.text: The text says the Client Registry cannot be governed unilaterally by the Ministry of Health because its data is referenced across government. Cross-government reference should not automatically give other sectors governance rights over health-identity data.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish consultation and interoperability governance from decision authority over health-sector data and access. Preserve health-sector accountability and legal purpose boundaries.
